items.title: Meta’s new AI agent just got me $250 in flight credits
items.summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen recounts how Muse, Meta's (META) new AI agent, helped get him $250 in flight credits and rebooked a new flight after his original flight was delayed, demonstrating how users can now interact with an agent that handles web-based tasks on their behalf and shifts the role of the operational driver from human to AI.

items.title: Should investors play AI bottlenecks over social media stocks?
items.summary: Should investors bet more on the AI infrastructure bottlenecks than on other tech trends, such as social media? Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick, and Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management CEO Ross Gerber.

items.title: Why Muse just added billions to Meta's market cap
items.summary: Why Muse is the new darling of Meta investors.

items.title: The Magnificent 7 are back: Meta’s AI bet leads the charge
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor and host of Sozzi Unleashed, Brian Sozzi, tees up the stories making waves across the markets. The Magnificent 7 are back in focus as megacap tech stocks help push markets higher, with Meta (META) leading the charge after its new Muse AI agent gained momentum and climbed to the top spot on Apple's (AAPL) App Store.

items.title: Why Meta's Muse AI agent is soaring in popularity
items.summary: Meta's (META) new Muse AI app is topping charts. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley, Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian, and Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman outline Muse's features and risks.

items.title: The return of the AI rally: What's fueling the latest push into tech?
items.summary: Leading AI stocks ripped higher to kick off this trading week as investors pile back into Big Tech. The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley weigh in on the market breadth of the equities participating in this latest rally.

items.title: VGT Holders Bought ‘Tech’ and Own No Google, Meta, or Amazon: The Sector Rule That Decides What’s Inside
items.summary: VGT promises tech exposure, but a classification rule buried in the index methodology quietly excludes three of the biggest names most investors assume they are buying. Knowing which ones changes how your whole portfolio actually fits together.

items.title: Power Integrations, Penguin Solutions, Photronics, Amkor, and Teradyne Shares Are Soaring, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after growing optimism surrounding agentic artificial intelligence and Meta Platforms' Muse application fueled expectations of higher demand for central processing units.
